_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
"The container" is the messages container (".messages-container"), "the button" the scroll-to-bottom button (".scroll-to-bottom-button"), and "the gap" the container's scrollHeight - clientHeight - scrollTop. To "send" a message, fill the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) with it and click the send button ([data-testid="send-button"]). Check every assertion with an eval that has "expect" (or an assert_* or wait_* step): an eval without "expect" asserts nothing. When a step says to record something, do it in one eval without "expect" that stores it in the named window variable, then check that variable. Perform the steps in order. The test seeds a conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} whose first message is "echo message 0". To "open the conversation", navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait for the message input to be visible (allow 30s). To "add message N", send "echo message N" and wait until a [data-testid="message"] element containing the text "echo message N" is visible (allow 30s). A clamped follow write does not disarm auto-follow (Safari estimate deflation). The page provides window.__springDeflationTrap(): it inserts a 600px spacer before the container's bottom sentinel, waits four animation frames for the follow branch to chase it, and if that follow writes a scrollTop more than 300px past the current one it collapses the spacer just before the write lands (as WebKit's estimates deflate), then removes the spacer and resolves to whether that happened.
1. Open the conversation.
2. Enough content that the list actually scrolls: add message 1 and wait until the agent-thinking indicator ([data-testid="agent-thinking"]) is hidden (allow 30s); then add message 2 and wait until the agent-thinking indicator ([data-testid="agent-thinking"]) is hidden (allow 30s); then add message 3 and wait until the agent-thinking indicator ([data-testid="agent-thinking"]) is hidden (allow 30s).
3. Wait until Math.abs(gap) <= 1 is true. The button must not be visible (allow 5s).
4. Retry until the trap actually fires: eval await window.__springDeflationTrap() expecting true, allowing 15s (the eval runs again until it returns true). scrollToBottom's animation-frame pin targets the current bottom, so only the estimate-inflated follow write springs the trap.
5. Settled state: the clamp left us at the true bottom, so the button must not be visible (allow 5s).
6. Send "echo after deflation" and wait until a [data-testid="message"] element containing "echo after deflation" is visible (allow 30s).
7. Still following: wait until Math.abs(gap) <= 1 is true, and the button must not be visible (allow 5s).
